overview.title: Your family
overview.emptyBody: Ask your family member for the link code in their Kneedit Profile, then link to them.

link.title: Link a family member
link.body: Ask your family member for the 6-character code in their Kneedit Profile, under Family and physiotherapist.

pending.title: Request sent
pending.body: Your family member needs to approve it. In Kneedit, they open Profile, then Family and physiotherapist.
pending.private: Until they approve, you see nothing about them.

member.needsPlus: This is part of Kneedit Plus. Tap the Plus badge to see what it includes.
member.reportOff: {{name}} has turned off the weekly report for family. {{name}} can turn it on again in Profile.

nudge.title: Send a gentle nudge
nudge.body: {{name}} sees it on the Today screen. You can send one a day.
nudge.sent: Nudge sent today. {{name}} sees it on the Today screen.

notes.title: Notes for the physiotherapist
notes.intro: Tell {{name}}'s physiotherapist how things are going at home. {{name}} and the rest of the family can read these notes too.
notes.fieldHint: For example, how the stairs or walking felt this week.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.intro: Possible falls the sleeve detects, and days in a row when {{name}} missed the exercises.
alerts.notEmergency: A possible fall is what the sleeve noticed. It may not be a real fall. Kneedit does not call for help, so if you are worried, contact {{name}} yourself.
alerts.fallsOff: {{name}} has turned off possible fall alerts for family. Missed-day alerts still show here.
alerts.missedDays_one: Missed the exercises {{value}} day in a row
alerts.missedDays_other: Missed the exercises {{value}} days in a row
alerts.missed: Missed the exercises several days in a row
alerts.demoBody: This is a demo account, so you can pretend the sleeve detected a possible fall. It is saved as sample data.

visits.title: {{name}}'s visits
visits.intro: Visits with {{name}}'s physiotherapist. Add one to your calendar to remember it.
visits.addToCalendarHint: Opens the visit in your calendar app
